mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings declines, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp MoM but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) and weak residential sales (RSAFS < 450000) indicate synchronized labor and consumer demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0% AND RSAFS < 450000 occurs but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) lead to higher equity discount rates and reduced valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Strong housing market activity (HOUST > 950) indicates robust consumer spending and business investment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST remains above 950 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that precedes corporate earnings weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 > 18000) indicate near-full capacity utilization that accelerates consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 > 18000 but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) signal recessionary conditions that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE > 6.0% occurs but S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
